problem_text:
A logistics coordinator needs to assign packages to identical delivery trucks. Packages:
* Package Alpha: size 58 cubic feet
* Package Beta: size 50 cubic feet
* Package Gamma: size 54 cubic feet
* Package Delta: size 62 cubic feet
* Package Epsilon: size 33 cubic feet
* Package Zeta: size 52 cubic feet
* Package Eta: size 54 cubic feet
* Package Theta: size 54 cubic feet
* Package Iota: size 65 cubic feet
* Package Kappa: size 38 cubic feet
* Package Lambda: size 64 cubic feet
* Package Mu: size 66 cubic feet
* Package Nu: size 39 cubic feet
* Package Xi: size 32 cubic feet
* Package Omicron: size 49 cubic feet
* Package Pi: size 69 cubic feet
* Package Rho: size 58 cubic feet
* Package Sigma: size 63 cubic feet
* Package Tau: size 66 cubic feet
* Package Upsilon: size 56 cubic feet
* Package Phi: size 43 cubic feet
* Package Chi: size 59 cubic feet
* Package Psi: size 43 cubic feet
* Package Omega: size 55 cubic feet
* Package Aleph: size 35 cubic feet
* Package Beth: size 36 cubic feet

Each truck can carry up to 100 cubic feet of cargo. Assign all packages using the fewest trucks possible. Every package must be loaded onto exactly one truck, and the total cargo volume in any truck cannot exceed its capacity.
